title: Training Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Training Manager to lead our training initiatives across various locations in India, particularly in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing training programs that enhance employee skills and performance. As a Training Manager, you will work closely with department heads to identify training needs and develop tailored training solutions that align with organizational goals. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for new and existing employees. - Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to identify skill gaps and training requirements. - Facilitate Train the Trainer (TTT) sessions to empower internal trainers. - Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback and performance metrics. - Collaborate with management to ensure training aligns with business objectives and employee development plans. - Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development. - Prepare and manage training budgets, ensuring cost-effective training solutions. Required Skills: - Proven experience as a Trainer or Training Manager in a BPO or similar environment. - Strong knowledge of training methodologies and adult learning principles. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to assess training effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. - Proficient in using training software and tools. If you are passionate about employee development and have a track record of successful training program implementation, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Head of HR Management India
description:
**Join DRÄXLMAIER Group and Shape the Future of People Management in India** 




  





 At DRÄXLMAIER Group, we create premium automotive solutions for leading vehicle manufacturers worldwide. Our people are at the heart of our success, and we are looking for a strategic and business\-oriented
 **Head of HR Management** 
 to lead our HR function in India.
 



  





 This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced HR leader to partner with business leaders, drive organizational effectiveness, develop talent, and build a high\-performance culture in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
 



  





**Your Mission**




 As Head of HR Management, you will be responsible for leading the full spectrum of Human Resources activities at our India operation while serving as a trusted advisor to the management team.
 



  





 You will shape and execute the local HR strategy in alignment with business objectives, ensuring that our people, culture, and organizational capabilities support sustainable growth and operational excellence.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Strategic HR Leadership** 



* Develop and execute the site's HR strategy aligned with business priorities.
* Partner closely with plant leadership and HR Asia on workforce and succession planning.
* Provide strategic guidance on organizational development and talent management.
* Drive HR initiatives that enhance business performance and employee engagement.



  





**People \& Talent Management** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, compensation, performance management, development, and succession planning.
* Build leadership capability and organizational effectiveness across the site.
* Oversee training and people development initiatives to meet current and future business needs.



  





**Employee Relations \& Compliance** 



* Serve as the key advisor on employment legislation, labor relations, and HR policies.
* Maintain productive relationships with employee representatives and external stakeholders.
* Ensure full compliance with local labor laws and company policies.
* Support organizational changes, restructuring, and workforce transformation initiatives when required.



  





**HR Operations Excellence** 



* Lead and develop the local HR team.
* Manage HR budgets and workforce planning.
* Monitor and report HR KPIs and workforce analytics.
* Drive continuous improvement of HR processes and employee experience.



  





  





**What You Bring**



* Master's Degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum
 **10 years of progressive HR experience** 
 , including leadership roles.
* Proven experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or multinational environments.
* Strong background across the full HR spectrum, including talent management, employee relations, organizational development, and labor law.
* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Deep understanding of Indian labor legislation and HR best practices.
* Proficiency in English; additional language skills are an advantage.
* Experience with SAP HR and Microsoft Office is preferred.



  





**Ready to Make an Impact?** 




 If you are a passionate HR leader who enjoys driving business success through people, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Apply now and become part of a global team shaping the future of mobility.**

title: Training & Development Manager
description:
TRAINING \& DEVELOPMENT MANAGER
   

  

 Foundry Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Position:** 
 Training \& Development Manager
   

  

**Department:** 
 Human Resources / Training \& Development
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 Years, preferably in Foundry / Manufacturing Industry
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 MBA / PGDM – HR / Training \& Development / MSW / Relevant Engineering Qualification
   

  

**Location:** 
 Wai Dist\-Satara Maharashtra
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and implement the annual Training \& Development plan based on organizational and departmental requirements.
* Identify Training Needs (TNI/TNA) based on competency gaps, performance, KRA and skill requirements.
* Develop and maintain skill matrix and competency matrices for employees, operators and technicians.
* Design training programs for new employees, existing employees, contract workers and temporary workers.
* Develop skill\-based training modules for Foundry operations such as:
+ Melting \& Furnace Operations
+ Moulding
+ Core Shop
+ Sand Plant
+ Fettling \& Shot Blasting
+ Quality \& Laboratory
+ Maintenance
+ Crane \& Material Handling
+ Gatecutting/Patternshop
+ Safety and Emergency Response

* Establish and monitor OJT, classroom and practical training programs.
* Develop training materials, SOP\-based training modules, work instructions and evaluation questionnaires.
* Conduct skill\-level assessments and competency evaluations for employees.
* Monitor effectiveness of training through post\-training evaluation, skill improvement and workplace performance.
* Maintain complete training records, attendance, assessment results and competency certification.
* Develop and implement L1/L2/L3/L4 skill certification systems as applicable.
* Coordinate with HODs and Section In\-Charges to identify critical skill gaps and improvement areas.
* Promote Kaizen, suggestion schemes, cross\-functional learning and continuous improvement.
* Monitor training KPIs and prepare monthly / quarterly Training MIS reports.
* Support new employee induction and job\-specific orientation programs.
* Ensure training compliance related to quality, safety, environment and customer requirements.
* Support internal / customer audits related to competency and training records.
* Develop internal trainers through a Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) program.


**Required Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Training Need Identification, Competency Development and Skill Matrix Management.
* Experience in shop\-floor training and operator skill development.
* Good understanding of foundry manufacturing processes will be preferred.
* Knowledge of KRA, KPI, competency assessment and performance management.
* Good presentation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, leadership and people\-management skills.
* Knowledge of 5S, Kaizen, Quality and Safety systems will be an advantage.


 Key Performance Areas
   

  

**Training Effectiveness \| Competency Development \| Skill Matrix \| Training Compliance \| Employee Development \| New Employee Training \| OJT Effectiveness \| Skill Certification \| Training MIS \| Continuous Improvement**
**Preferred Candidate**
 Candidates with experience in
 **Foundry / Automotive / Engineering / Manufacturing Industries** 
 , particularly in
 **shop\-floor skill development and technical training** 
 , will be preferred.
   

  

**Additional Benefits:** 
 PF / Mediclaim / Leave Payment
   

  

**Facility:** 
 Accommodation provided free of cost
   

  

 subsidiary Canteen /Transport facility
